text: Authenticate users via Azure AD single sign-on limited to the Nursing Staff group
Display a real-time ward patient list filtered by nurse's assigned ward, refreshed every 30 seconds
Allow nurses to select a patient from the ward list to enter a ward note
Provide a rich text editor for nurses to compose and submit ward notes
Submit ward notes to both Epic EHR via FHIR R4 API and to a ward tracking Excel spreadsheet via Microsoft Graph API
Append each ward note as a new row in the spreadsheet with fields: Patient MRN, Timestamp, Nurse ID, Note Text, Source System, and Note ID (transaction ID)
Ensure idempotent note submission using a unique transaction ID to prevent duplicate rows
Enforce a 10-second timeout for note delivery to Epic and the spreadsheet, showing error and allowing retry on timeout
Cache the last 10 notes entered by the nurse during the current shift locally, showing them on the main screen for context
Support discarding a note in progress, clearing the editor and local cache without logging an audit trail
Detect patient discharge or transfer status changes during note entry and show a warning banner without blocking editing
Block submission of notes for discharged patients at send time, keeping the note in the editor until nurse selects a different patient or discards it
Persist pending notes locally with retry logic surviving app restarts, retrying automatically in background for up to 24 hours
After three transient submission failures, display a persistent banner allowing nurse to retry or discard the note
Skip retries and immediately show failure banner for permanent errors such as invalid MRN or rejected notes from Epic
Log all note submissions and access events with audit trails stored in Azure SQL Database with row-level security and 6-year retention
Send a daily summary email to each ward manager’s configured email address listing all notes submitted that day, grouped by patient and nurse
Validate user group membership at login using Azure AD group claims to restrict app access to authorized nursing staff only
Provide confirmation message after successful note submission showing transaction ID
Use managed Azure services hosted in US East region with compliance to HIPAA and HITRUST, encrypting PHI at rest and in transit
